# `aube access ls`

- **Usage:** `aube access ls [ENTITIES]…`
- **Effect:** read-only

Alias for `list packages`.

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/publishing) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`[ENTITIES]…`** — User, `@organization`, or `@scope:team`. Also accepts pnpm's `packages [ENTITY]` compatibility form. Accepted forms are `aube access ls [ENTITY]` and `aube access ls packages [ENTITY]`.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
